newsitem.title: JAPAN: Eisai climbs on Alzheimer's drug approval.
newsitem.headline: Eisai climbs on Alzheimer's drug approval.

text.p: Eisai Co Ltd climbed on Wednesday morning, inspired by news that it had received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for its Alzheimer's drug Aricept, brokers said.
At midday, the shares were up 20 yen at 2,200 yen, the 13th most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on trade of 1.43 million shares.
Eisai said in a statement that its U.S. subsidiary, Eisai America Inc, received approval for the new drug in the United States on Monday.
Aricept is a drug for mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease, the company said.
Another Eisai unit in the United States would start selling the drug there in January, an Eisai spokesman said.
